# meshtastic-mcp

> An MCP server and agent skills for discovering, driving, observing and testing Meshtastic
> radios and the apps that talk to them. A few intent tools (`devices`, `inspect`,
> `configure`, `send`, `admin`, `install`, `query`, `sim`, `app`) cover most work; specialist
> groups add more. Run `meshtastic-mcp doctor` to see what this host can do.

Generated by `meshtastic-mcp docs generate`; do not edit.

## Skills

- [meshtastic-device-ops](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-device-ops/SKILL.md): Discover, connect to, drive, configure, observe, and flash Meshtastic devices through the Meshtastic MCP server
- [meshtastic-e2e](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-e2e/SKILL.md): Closed-loop end-to-end testing of a Meshtastic device and a Meshtastic app (Android, Apple, or the Compose desktop app) together
- [meshtastic-org-knowledge](src/meshtastic_mcp/skills/meshtastic-org-knowledge/SKILL.md): Find and answer questions across all Meshtastic GitHub repos — what projects exist, what their docs say, their current status (releases, open PRs/issues, recent commits), and how they relate
